Fan Reviews

Rose
July 1st 2025
A Perfect Circle and Tool were awesome, but we couldn't stay for the whole show. Not because Primus wasn’t awesome (they absolutely were 🤘), but because when they came on, a flow of rather drunk fans entered the lawn area and there was zero security or any control to help. People were smoking right next to me (you’re not supposed to smoke in here), people talking so loudly you could barely hear the music over their conversations, drinks being tossed left and right, and all while someone was also trying to FIGHT ME for a chair I rented. We tried moving, but the latter followed, and security would not help (ironic since the last time I was here security was so uptight they would yell at you for having even one foot in the paved path). Hard to enjoy a good show when you've got someone trying to fight you (and eat oranges with you… they kept changing between what they wanted to do) while also trying to deal with everyone else being extra around you. Ended up having to leave slightly early.
Ridgefield, WA@
Cascades Amphitheater
Cass M
May 25th 2025
This show was other worldly. We went to the Sessanta tour last year in Raleigh and just knew we had to go again. I felt like I was transported to a world where my brain could just fully revel in the music, the lights, and the vibe. I absolutely love Puscifer. Primus was amazing and A Perfect Circle is a rare treat to be seen. I'll never pass up a chance to see Puscifer and APC.
Pittsburgh, PA@
Petersen Events Center
Sean
May 13th 2025
2nd time seeing them. So good! Glad I finally got to see them play Judith which they skipped the first time I saw them but wish they played more songs from the first 2 albums especially mer de noms as Judith was the only one played from that album. Got to also mark seeing one of my favorite drummers of all time play live off my bucket list (Josh Freese)!
Tampa, FL@
MIDFLORIDA Credit Union Amphitheatre
Melissa
May 1st 2025
This was a fantastic show! First time I've seen any. My jaw was dropped in amazing awwh the entire show! Primus with that hard bass out of this world literally. Good job too the entire professional staff at isleta venue. Thank you too all crowd feeling the same positive vibe. Not one negative about the entire night other than certain merch selling out. Thank you perfect circle Thank you purifier Thank you Thank you primus for an unforgettable eve. Gratitude too isleta for having us:)
Albuquerque, NM@
Isleta Amphitheater
Rhonda
January 28th 2025
This show, all 3 bands, the stadium, and the location made for the perfect experience! My husband and I had tickets to the show in April in NJ however I had to give up my ticket last minute. I was heartbroken. My husband then surprised me with tickets to this show, the last show of the 2024 Sessanta Tour. The location of the stadium was perfect! It's on a busy street but there are many different places to eat and shop, if time allows. The stadium was small, but not too small. I best described it to friends as "cozy" with incredible acoustics! I searched 2025's Tour in this same stadium however, sadly, there is no show here. We plan to get back to the stadium for another show in the near future!
Forest Hills, NY@
Forest Hills Stadium
Ellen
April 22nd 2024
It was amazing! I've been a Perfect Circle fan since day one. It was great to hear and see them in top form. I loved how the concert flowed, alternating between bands and the various collaborations. I never listened to Primus much before, but they really grew on me. Puscifer was also great. The time flew by and I loved every minute.
Berkeley, CA@
The Greek Theatre Berkeley
Robb
November 24th 2018
First time seeing any form of MJK projects and would have had nothing but superlatives to say. However, even though the performance was outstanding, the fans were less so. As if expecting the next Tool album to be included in their APC ticket purchase, the crowd on the floor was so constipated with misplaced negative energy, they actually booed the opening act, and refused to hear the message of even the music of A Perfect Circle. Namely, wake up and get out of your little island of entitlement.
Las Vegas, NV@
The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas - The Chelsea
Mike
November 15th 2018
The sound of MJK's voice filled the arena and it was very moving. He has a gift and all of us are privileged to be able to enjoy listening to it. The band itself is in a class of their own. Makes me glad to be alive. I took my 17 year old daughter and she too was moved to tears due to Maynard's voice and the musicianship of the band. I would just like to thank A Perfect Circle for coming back together and creating one of the greatest albums in the history of music.
Cedar Rapids, IA@
U.S. Cellular Center
Dawn
November 9th 2018
It was great! My first time seeing them live. Yeah, sucked not being allowed to take pics or videos, but whatever. The only thing that disappointed me most was the new version of 3 Libras. It’s my favorite of their and it was kind of a disaster. Didn’t recognize it at all until the end when you finally hear a few lyrics then it was done. All in all, it was awesome, he sounds incredible live!
Charlotte, NC@
Bojangles' Coliseum
Paul
November 9th 2018
I have seen Tool and APC numerous times over the years and I have never heard Maynard's voice sound so clear and melodic. Overall sound of the band was near perfect. Thank God I dug into the comments on the Bandsintown app to find out who the opening act was. I was shocked to see that Tricky was one of the two openers! Why this wasn't marketed is beyond me. Tricky has been making amazing music for over 20 years and put on an amazing (but way too short) set of solo and Massive Attack tunes. This new venue is nice although the beer lines were way too long and they ran out of everything except Coors Light. The most disappointing thing was the low turnout for this show. They played Madison Square Garden the night before, yet barely filled two thirds of this much smaller arena. With so many empty seats, it was hard to get a good crowd vibe going. I nitpicked some things but, overall, APC couldn't have been better and the sound was impeccable.
Baltimore, MD@
UMBC Event Center
Sam
November 8th 2018
A Perfect Circle was phenomenal as always. Music was perfect and Maynard has such an amazing voice. 5 stars for A Perfect Circle. The opening bands were awful, but A Perfect Circle made up for it. The Hulu theater was not an enjoyable venue. The seating is tight and it was actually very warm in the theater. I'd give the venue 3 stars.
New York, NY@
Hulu Theater at Madison Square Garden
Thomas
November 8th 2018
Really enjoyed A Perfect Circles set. I gave it 4 stars for two very annoying reasons. First the no camera announcement was played on loop outside the theater and was a super frustrating concert experience. Then the band annouces your welcome to take out your phones for the last song, didn't land very well. Second, I assume the headliner stipulates the opening acts on what type of volume they can play or the headliner brought addition speakers and didn’t open them up to the opening acts. The simple outcome was the opening acts experience was more of a Hight School PA auditorium levels from our 204 section seats that were $240 for two tickets. So a premium cost venue with a PA decibel level experience. Its a rock concert even if your adjusting dB levels for your aging demographic please still provide your open acts the ability to be heard and enjoyed. Otherwise, Perfect Circle has great energy and played a good mix of the old tunes and new content. I loved the color scheme to highlight which album the song came from, it was a very cool and welcomed touch.
New York, NY@
Hulu Theater at Madison Square Garden
AYarb
November 3rd 2018
Loved the show!!! 2 reasons I couldn’t give it 5 stars. 1, is the set list. I knew songs from the new album would be played, of course, only wish they had played some more of their older songs as well. Also, HATE the version of 3 Libras they are playing now. Makes no sense to me to change such such an epic , awesome song. The “new” version just sounds like a mess. Can’t even hear the words through all the “techno” type crap they did to it. 2, hated that we never really saw MJK. Focused more on the music, yes...but wish we could have seen him perform out with the band. He stood in a shadow in the back the ENTIRE time, and left abruptly before the end of the last song. Love APC, always have, always will. Would def see them again. Just my opinions.
Charlotte, NC@
Bojangles' Coliseum
Matt
October 21st 2018
It was an excellent show, they had great stage presence! The lightning was a little dim but I am sure that was intentional. We had the stage tour package and that was good. We were served milk and cookies in place of wine due to Utah laws on importing alcohol. I don’t drink though so that in fine with me. 🤣😂🤣 all around great show and sound was better than most in that venue.
West Valley City, UT@
Maverik Center
Peter
June 13th 2018
As usual Maynard was out of sight for the gig. The sound varied a lot but at least his vocals were clear. It went from bone shaking bass to quite feeble bass on the package, (the only song I wanted extreme bass!) a good selection across the albums. We all want a certain song to be played and feel great if we get it but think if only they had played...last night was no different. Come out of the shadows now and again Keenan but keep up the good work.

O2 Apollo Manchester

June 7th 2018
Visually it was beautiful. All the lights that was on the scene and out of the scene made the atmospheric behind the songs even deeper. Oslo Spektrum Arena

November 26th 2017
Great concert, impressive lighting. Maynard still sounds the same and the new stuff is great. The only problem with APC concerts is that they draw Tool fans which for the most part are total tools themselves and the assigned seating means getting away from them and there inane homophobic quips is impossible. UIC Pavilion

June 19th 2017
They put on a great show. I was just a bit disappointed they didn't play Judith, though. Also, cameras weren't allowed, including camera phones. If they caught you, you could be ejected. Manny
April 2nd 2017
Show was amazing, it was my first time seeing APC live. The venue was nice and the seats were great but the event staff was overly aggressive with the no cellphone policy. Saw a couple of scuffles break out with security and they kept blasting their flashlights into the crowd at people of their cellphones. The flashlights in the face every few minutes did put a damper on it for the rest of us, especially since APC is a total live experience and the light show is part of that. Unless one of my favorites artists comes to this venue I will not be returning.
Houston, TX@
Smart Financial Centre SOLD OUT

Amazing show and great sound. Getting to hear some of my fav songs live for the first time and with the impressive skill and quality of performance from James and billy was like a dream come true. A little bummed they didn't play my favs (Pet, Judith, and 3 Libras) but so glad I finally got to see them; 14 year old me would be so proud. One day, I hope I'll be able to shake their hands. Just amazing work.
